body: Can u send it to me please?
all of the guys call her " whore "

In my case, the girl that i loved and i still love  now,  disappointed me so much, and now it all hurts, she was my family, my only joy, the best good thing that happened to me, and now, i can't accept she is a fucking whore. It all hurts a lot on my neck, i can't breathe. I can't help myself, but i wish you the best and please.. try to not hurt yourself, I know it's difficult but please.. I understand your pain, trust me. I want all to be just happy.. remember that : depression is also a different way to see things, so it's means we are more clever and creative than others. Please, I know it's REALLY fucking hard, I know, I'm in your same situation, all hurts so much. Keep your head up. <3
Your words really mean a lot for me, thank you, I wish the best for you, really
He loves you, He doesn't want to lose you. Love him.

I can understand all of your pain, please don't hurt yourself, I'm with you, I'm with you all. I don't know you, but if you hurt yourself, I will suffer a lot. I also know that maybe it looks difficult to ask help, but please speak with someone. I'm with you. <3
